## Runtime and packages

- Node.js: `>=22.13.0`
- React: `^19.0.0`
- Express: `^5.1.0`
- Vite: `^7.0.0`
- Persistence: Node.js built-in SQLite

## Navigation

- Overview
- Recurring bills
- Shared expenses
- Debts & goals
- To-do list
- Settings & profiles

Overview includes the monthly cash-flow breakdown and extra spending.

## HTTP routes

Routes are relative to the application mount point. The auth action accepts `register` or `login`. See [architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md) for trust boundaries.

| Method | Path |
| --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/session` |
| POST | `/api/auth/:action` |
| POST | `/api/recovery/reset` |
| POST | `/api/logout` |
| GET | `/api/security` |
| POST | `/api/security/revoke-others` |
| POST | `/api/security/password` |
| POST | `/api/security/recovery-code` |
| GET | `/api/state` |
| PUT | `/api/state` |
| GET | `/{*path}` |

See [deployment](DEPLOYMENT.md) for defaults and safe configuration.

## Account state collections

- `profiles`
- `bills`
- `debts`
- `payments`
- `expenses`
- `tasks`

Income changes, bill versions and paid snapshots are nested in their profile/bill records. Appearance preferences are account-level; tracker preferences are profile-level.

## Appearance

- Forest (`forest`)
- Ocean (`ocean`)
- Violet (`violet`)
- Rose (`rose`)
- Amber (`amber`)
- Slate (`slate`)

Each theme supports light, dark and system appearance.
